claims.claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows by defining multi-agent orchestration contracts and human override escalation paths.
Advanced CFO-aligned adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization through enterprise workflow adoption and usage-based forecasting.
Strengthened production governance with audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows, pairing evaluation gates with telemetry and rollback controls.
Accelerated the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks by standardizing managed workflow orchestration, replayable runtime design, and exit disposition governance.
Architected high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across cloud data infrastructure, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a disciplined operating model.
